NEHU Project Assistant/ Intern Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for North Eastern Hill University (NEHU), a prominent educational institution in the North Eastern region of India.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Project Assistant/Intern, offering an opportunity for individuals to contribute to university projects.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Assistant/Intern post, making it a competitive opportunity for interested candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview, allowing direct interaction with the selection committee on the specified date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Assistant/Intern post is scheduled for 17 September 2026. Candidates should report on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree in a relevant discipline, such as Food, Agriculture, Life Sciences, Humanities, Social Sciences, or Indigenous Knowledge Systems, with proficiency in spoken Garo language.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Project Assistant/Intern?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Assistant/Intern post is Rs. 10000 Per Month, providing a fixed remuneration for the duration of the contract.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment, making it accessible to all eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of NEHU?
faq.answer: The official website for North Eastern Hill University (NEHU) is www.nehu.ac.in, where candidates can find more information and updates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant/Intern post involves a Walk-in Interview, where candidates will be assessed based on their qualifications and performance.
